The .secure Format: Invented & Introduced by Coralgenz Global

The .secure format was invented and introduced by Coralgenz Global, and all rights are owned by the company. Traditional cloud storage holds encryption keys on servers, leaving sensitive data vulnerable to intercept and unauthorized exposure. Coralgenz Global solved this fundamentally by inventing the .secure file format: every file is transformed into an encrypted self-verifying container directly inside your browser before a single byte touches the network.

🔒 AES-GCM-256 Bit ⚡ 0% Server Knowledge 🌐 In-Browser Runtime 🛡️ Anti-Tamper Header
